svg.title: The CDR body of a GIOP 1.2 Request
svg.desc: The body of frame 4 of corba.pcap, a big-endian GIOP 1.2 Request, 32 bits per row. CDR aligns every primitive on its size: the 2-byte Target discriminant is followed by 2 bytes of padding before the object key length, and the operation name echo with its NUL is followed by 3 bytes of padding before the service context count. The GiopRequest fields come out as request_id 0, response_flags 3, target KeyAddr of 60 bytes, operation echo, one service context and 76 bytes of stub data.
